Admission.description:
How `prompt.submit` admitted an input (spec: tui, Prompt submission
while busy).

oneOf.description:
A turn was running: it runs after the queued inputs before it
(`busy.input_mode = "queue"`, or `interrupt`, which stops the
running turn first).

Handed to the running turn after its current tool step
(`busy.input_mode = "steer"`).

ApprovalAnswer.description:
The answer to `approval.request` (also `approval.respond` params,
with its `id`).

accepted_hunks.description: For a diff approval: the hunks accepted.

replacement.description: An edited command to run instead.

fragment.description: The offending part, invisible characters escaped.

deadline_ms.description:
Milliseconds until the request settles unanswered (set by the
daemon when it sends the request).

subject.description: The command line or written path.

accepted_hunks.description: For a diff approval: the hunks accepted.

replacement.description: An edited command to run instead.

epoch.description:
The daemon epoch `last_seen_seq` belongs to; another epoch than the
daemon's answers `truncated: true` and replays nothing.

last_seen_seq.description:
The newest sequence number the client applied: the kept events
after it are replayed before the answer.

AttachRole.description: What an attached connection may do in the session.

oneOf.description: Submits, interrupts and answers the session's requests.

Reads only: receives events, never server requests, and may not
submit (`-32002 session.observer`).

epoch.description: The daemon epoch the sequence numbers belong to.

latest_seq.description: The newest event sequence number kept for it.

open_requests.description:
Requests of the session still waiting for an answer (re-sent to
this connection when it is a capable driver).

truncated.description:
Events after the client's `last_seen_seq` were evicted, or the
client's epoch is not this daemon's: reload the transcript
(`session.transcript`) instead of applying the replayed events.

BannerInfo.description: `session.banner` result: what the TUI's startup banner lists.

skills.description: The installed skills the session can load.

system_prompt.description: The frozen system prompt; none before the first turn.

tools.description: The session's tool names, in request order.

answers.description: One answer per question, as the `clarify` tool defines them.

deadline_ms.description:
Milliseconds until the request settles unanswered (set by the
daemon when it sends the request).

questions.description: The questions, as the `clarify` tool defines them.

events.description:
Events introduced after the client's minor version that it
understands anyway.

server_requests.description:
The client answers server-to-client requests (approvals, clarify,
secrets, sudo). Without it they resolve unanswered at once.

commands.description: Every command of the session, by name.

aliases.description: Other names that resolve to it.

args.description: The argument synopsis (`<name> [--now]`), when it takes any.

disposition.description: Whether it runs from the asking client's surface.

reason.description: Why it does not run there.

source.description: Built-in, quick command, skill or client-handled.

oneOf.description: A built-in command of the daemon's registry.
Handled by the client itself (never dispatched).

focus.description: What the summary should keep in focus.

prefix.description:
What is typed so far (`/mod` for a command, `./src/ma` for a path,
without the `@` of a mention).

dir.description: A directory (path completion continues inside it).

text.description: The completed text that replaces the prefix.

profile.description: The profile; required when the connection is granted several.

value.description: Its effective value (secrets are never configuration values).

context_window.description: The model's context window, when known.

cost_usd.description:
The session's cost so far in the usage ledger's currency (USD),
priced calls only.

tokens.description: Estimated tokens of the active context.

oneOf.description: Allow matching calls for the rest of the session.
Allow matching calls from now on (recorded in `grants.toml`).

DispatchParams.description:
`command.dispatch` params: a slash command the client does not handle
itself (spec: tui, Slash command flow).

args.description: The rest of the line, case kept.

name.description: The command name without `/` (an alias or unique prefix resolves).

oneOf.description: The command ran; `notice` is its output to show.

Disposition.description: Where a command runs from this surface.

Envelope.description: One event frame: the notification params and the replay item.

data.description: The payload, as the event's contract defines it.

seq.description:
Per-session monotonic sequence number (per daemon for daemon-wide
events).

session_id.description: The session it belongs to; `None` for daemon-wide events.

epoch.description:
The daemon epoch; a different one than the client's means the
daemon restarted and the client resets its watermark.

events.description: The kept events after `last_seen`, oldest first.

latest_seq.description: The newest sequence number of the session.

open_requests.description: Requests of the session still waiting for an answer.

last_seen.description: The last sequence number the client saw (0 for none).

at_message_id.description:
The last message the fork keeps (`msg_<ULID>`); default the
session's last active message.

FrozenPrompt.description: The system prompt a session froze on its first turn.

text.description: The prompt text, its tiers joined in request order.

HelloParams.description: `rpc.hello` params: the first request on every connection.

build_id.description:
The daemon's build id; a client with another one shows the
stale-build notice.

epoch.description: Random per daemon start; event sequence numbers restart with it.

instance_id.description: Random per daemon start; tickets are bound to it.

profiles.description: The profiles the connection's ticket grants.

McpServerState.description: One MCP server of a session.

context_window.description: The model's context window, when known.

models.description: The models a `/model` switch may pick, current first.

OpenRequest.description: A server-to-client request still waiting for an answer.

PlatformSupport.description: The daemon's build target and its support tier.

PromptImage.description:
An image attached to a prompt: a file the daemon reads (checked like
`chat --image`), or an image the session already holds (as
`command.dispatch` returns them for `/retry`).

oneOf.description: An absolute path on the daemon's machine.

A blob reference (`blob:sha256:<hex>`) of one of the session's
earlier user messages.

RequestCancel.description: `request.cancel` payload: a server request timed out or was cancelled.

reason.description:
`timeout`, `cancelled`, or `no_responder` (no attached driver can
answer: none was attached when it was asked, or the last one left).

by_client.description: The client that answered (`<client kind>-<connection number>`).

oneOf.description: `-r <ref>`: an id, an id prefix, a title or `latest`.

`-c [<name>]`: the newest CLI session of the directory (empty
reference) or the newest session of the lineage titled `name`.

profile.description: The profile; required only when the ticket grants several.

terminal.description:
The client terminal's identity (prefers the session last used from
it for a bare `-c`).

exclusive.description:
Become the session's interactive owner; fails with `-32004
session.in_use` naming the owner's pid while another connection is.

setup.description:
How the session runs from now on; a loaded, idle session is
reloaded with it. Absent: as it is (or the profile's defaults).

deadline_ms.description:
Milliseconds until the request settles unanswered (set by the
daemon when it sends the request).

events.description: The events it may send this client.

methods.description:
The methods with a handler (the rest of the catalog answers
`rpc.not_served`).

server_requests.description: The server-to-client requests it may send.

cwd.description: The working directory of the session.

exclusive.description:
Make this connection the session's interactive owner: another
connection resuming it exclusively is refused while it is attached.

idempotency_key.description:
Retries with the same key within 300 s return the same session
instead of creating another one.

profile.description: The profile; required only when the ticket grants several.

setup.description: How the session runs (a chat's flags).

source.description:
The client creating it; must be the connection's own `client`
kind (`-32002 rpc.source_mismatch` otherwise). Absent: the
connection's kind.

source_tag.description: A source tag recorded on the session.

limit.description: At most this many, newest activity first (default 50).

profile.description: The profile; required only when the ticket grants several.

SessionSetup.description:
How a daemon session runs: the session-shaping flags of `prometheus
chat`, applied when the session loads (spec: cli, Daemon attachment
with in-process fallback).

api_key.description: That endpoint's API key (`--api-key-stdin`), held in memory only.

base_url.description: An endpoint for this session only (`--base-url`).

ignore_rules.description:
No rule files, identity file, memory snapshot or preloaded skills
(`--ignore-rules`).

ignore_user_config.description:
Schema defaults instead of the profile's `config.toml`
(`--ignore-user-config`).

mock_script.description: A mock provider script on the daemon's machine (`--mock-script`).

model.description:
The model (`[<provider>/]<model>` or an alias) instead of the
profile's (`-m`).

pass_session_id.description: The system prompt names the session id (`--pass-session-id`).

provider.description: The provider instead of the profile's (`--provider`).

set.description:
`key=value` configuration overrides for this session only (`--set`,
`--approvals`, `--max-iterations`, `--toolsets`).

live.description: Whether a turn is running in the daemon.

title.description: Its title, when it has one.

SubagentSummary.description: One delegated child of a session.

author.description:
Never accepted: the gateway stamps every input's author from the
connection, so a client-supplied one is refused with `-32002
rpc.forged_author`.

input_id.description:
The client's id of this input: a resend with the same id returns
the original admission instead of running a second turn.

run_budget_secs.description: Wall-clock budget of this turn in seconds (`--run-budget`).

Submitted.description:
`prompt.submit` result: the input was admitted; its turn's output
arrives as events.

turn_id.description:
The admission id: the turn that runs the input (for a steered
input, the running turn it joined).

command.description: The command that needs the password.

deadline_ms.description:
Milliseconds until the request settles unanswered (set by the
daemon when it sends the request).

text.description: Its text, when it has any.

TurnError.description: Why a turn ended in error.

kind.description: The error taxonomy kind (it fixes a CLI's exit status).

error.description: The error that ended the turn.

final_response.description: The final answer, when there is one.

report.description:
The turn's `--usage-file` report (session, lineage root, route,
billing source, tokens, cost and cost status of its model calls).

usage.description: The turn's token and cost totals, as the turn loop reports them.

Version.description: A `<major>.<minor>` protocol version on the wire.
